identity.name: Cascade Marathon
identity.tagline: A point-to-point Boston qualifying race from the foothills to the coast.

seo.meta_description: Cascade Marathon is a point-to-point Boston qualifying race from the Cascade foothills to Pacific City, Oregon on September 20, 2026.

travel_logistics.headline: Getting There / Where to Stay
travel_logistics.intro: Make the mountain-to-coast weekend easy to plan with arrival, lodging, shuttle, and packet-pickup details in one place.

items.label: Getting here
items.title: Fly into Portland
items.text: Use Portland as the arrival hub, then follow race-weekend guidance to the start village and coastal finish.

items.label: Race-day movement
items.title: Use race shuttles and host hotels
items.text: Host-hotel and shuttle guidance can keep runners from solving point-to-point logistics on race morning.

items.label: Where to stay
items.title: Book by start or finish preference
items.text: Choose lodging near the start for a calmer morning or near the coast for an easier finish-line recovery.

items.label: Packet pickup
items.title: Collect bibs before race morning
items.text: Packet pick-up and expo details should sit alongside travel planning so runners know when to arrive.
